findings.title: KeyError when Integration metadata lacks sender
findings.body: GitHubInstallation.dispatch does integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] with direct dict indexing. Integrations created before sender was stored, or where build_integration had no state sender, have no metadata sender key. That raises KeyError resulting in a 500 instead of the intended github-integration-failed error page, breaking reinstall/repair flows for existing installs.

findings.title: Unhandled token-exchange/userinfo failures cause 500
findings.body: OAuthLoginView calls safe_urlopen for the access_token exchange and get_user_info without try/except, then checks "login" not in authenticated_user_info. Network errors, non-2xx responses, ApiError from the user API, or a None return all raise instead of returning the error template. A GitHub outage, bad/reused code, or malformed user response turns installation into a 500 rather than the intended Invalid installation request page.

findings.title: installation_not_found test no longer covers 404 path
findings.body: test_installation_not_found stubs a 404 for /app/installations but then calls setup with state ddd023d87a913d5226e2a882c4c4cc05 which does not equal the pipeline signature. The request therefore fails at the state-mismatch check in OAuthLoginView and asserts Invalid installation request. The build_integration 404 branch raising The GitHub installation could not be found is never exercised.
